title: Find the names of cards that are legal in the format which has the most ban
question: Find the names of cards that are legal in the format which has the most banned cards overall, have full artwork, and are available in an Italian translation.

prediction.sql:
WITH MaxBanned AS (
    SELECT "XCL_084" AS fmt
    FROM legalities
    WHERE "XCL_085" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "XCL_084"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l."XCL_086" = c."XCL_072"
JOIN MaxBanned AS mb ON mb.fmt = l."XCL_084"
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st."XCL_093" = c."XCL_063"
WHERE l."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND c."XCL_018" LIKE '%extendedart%'
  AND st."XCL_092" = 'Italian'

WITH MaxBanned AS (
    SELECT "XCL_084" AS fmt
    FROM legalities
    WHERE "XCL_085" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "XCL_084"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l."XCL_086" = c."XCL_072"
JOIN MaxBanned AS mb ON mb.fmt = l."XCL_084"
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st."XCL_093" = c."XCL_063"
WHERE l."XCL_085" = 'Legal'
  AND c."XCL_018" LIKE '%extendedart%'
  AND st."XCL_092" = 'Italian'

    SELECT "XCL_084" AS fmt
    FROM legalities
    WHERE "XCL_085" = 'Banned'
    GROUP BY "XCL_084"
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT c."XCL_049"
FROM cards AS c
JOIN legalities AS l ON l."XCL_086" = c."XCL_072"
JOIN MaxBanned AS mb ON mb.fmt = l."XCL_084"
JOIN set_translations AS st ON st."XCL_093" = c."XCL_063"
